seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [player,target,wall] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,y x1, h,pixels,w,x,y x1, pixels,w,x x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Frame-native 21x21 block model: H axis (row, A1/A2) and V axis (col, A3/A4); selection shown by 0 centres; A5 cycles H->V->pieces by min block->H.
Reflection A4 mixed outcome = not an own-field condition: A4 moves the V axis (or the selected piece) and the mirror sprites follow, so re-extracted reflections change h/w/x/y/pixels.
Pieces blocked by board edge/other pieces; axes bounded by the board only and pass under pieces.
Each piece block mirrors as gray 4 across V, H and both (skip off-board/piece-occupied); centre priority target 11 > selected wall 0 > selected piece 0 > refl 4 > bg 9.
HUD col 63 turns next 11->12 only on effective actions; stateless. Unconfirmed: piece entering an axis row.
